description: Bhakoot (Rashi / Bhakut) koota — emotional bonding, family welfare and prosperity, from the mutual rashi-to-rashi position of the two Moon signs. Certain positional relationships form a Bhakoot dosha and score 0; all others score the full 7.

counting_rule.description: Compute the count from rashi A to rashi B (inclusive, forward) and from B to A. The unordered pair of counts identifies the relationship. Same rashi = 1/1.
counting_rule.formula_note: count_ab = ((B - A) mod 12) + 1 ; count_ba = ((A - B) mod 12) + 1

penalized_relationships._comment: Each is an unordered pair of mutual counts that constitutes a Bhakoot dosha (score 0).

scoring.rule: If the unordered pair of mutual counts equals {2,12}, {5,9}, or {6,8} -> 0 (Bhakoot dosha). Otherwise -> 7.

notes: Bhakoot is symmetric: swapping the two rashis yields the same count-pair, so directional=false.
Bhakoot dosha is a common candidate for classical cancellation (e.g. same rashi-lord, or lords being mutual friends). No cancellation is applied unless explicitly enabled in exceptions.json.
6/8 (Shad-Ashtaka) and 2/12 (Dwir-Dwadasha) are traditionally regarded as the more serious; some schools weight them differently — this pack applies a uniform 0 for all three. review_required.
